items.headline: Indian Stock Market Opens Lower Amid Global Headwinds; RBI Rate Hike Anticipated
items.summary: The Indian stock market commenced October on a subdued note, with benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty opening lower, extending a three-day losing streak due to elevated global bond yields, FII selling, and geopolitical tensions. The RBI's MPC is expected to hike the repo rate by 25 bps (Oct 5-7) amid rising CPI (4.82% in Aug), high crude oil prices ($103-$107 per barrel), and a depreciating rupee (past 96 to the US dollar).

items.headline: Government reduces export levy on diesel and ATF
items.summary:
The government has reduced the export levy on diesel to \u20b916 per litre (from 
\u20b920) and on Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) to 
\u20b910.5 per litre (from 
\u20b915).

items.headline: Global Markets Mixed; Elevated US Yields and FII Selling Impact Indian Market
items.summary: Global markets are mixed. Softer US inflation data offered some relief, but concerns persist over elevated US Treasury yields and stalled US-Iran peace talks (contributing to volatile crude prices). Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) consistently sold equities, offloading \u20b99,980.22 crore on Tuesday and \u20b910,148 crore on Wednesday.

items.headline: Q2 Earnings Expected to Bring Temporary Cheer Amid Q3 Caution
items.summary: While Q2 earnings are expected to bring temporary cheer, investors are cautious about potential poorer Q3 earnings due to energy shocks and supply chain disruptions.

items.headline: Nifty IT, Private Bank indices gain; Auto, Metal, Pharma decline
items.summary: Nifty IT and Nifty Private Bank indices showed marginal gains in early trade, with Infosys, TCS, Tech Mahindra, and Mphasis among top IT gainers. Banking heavyweights provided support. Railway stocks like IRCTC, RVNL, and Ircon rallied up to 14%. Conversely, Auto, Media, Realty, Metal, and Pharma indices witnessed declines.
